summary: Restart after a crash without deleting /dev/shm by hand; keep the LMCache disk tier within its disk
details: A RAM cache arena left in /dev/shm by a container that was killed or crashed no longer blocks the next start with "Refusing to reuse an existing cache SHM arena": the supervisor holds a lock for as long as its container runs, and an arena without a live owner is removed.

At startup the LMCache disk tier (LMCACHE_L2_GB) is capped, with a warning, to 90% of what its filesystem can give it (free space plus the tier's existing files), so it cannot fill the disk and crash the container.
